info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Preapprovals-v2-spec
info.description: This API provides access to a list of mortgage loan preapprovals, allowing users to efficiently retrieve and review potential mortgage options. It serves as a vital resource for financial institutions, mortgage brokers, and homebuyers aiming to assess available preapproval scenarios based on user input and criteria. This capability supports informed decision-making, streamlining the loan application process by providing transparency into consumer financing options. Typical consumers include mortgage advisors, lenders, and real estate professionals needing to reference current preapproval statuses.

get.description: Fetch the current preapproval status for loan applications. This endpoint allows users to check whether their loan requests have been preapproved, providing insight into potential borrowing options.

requestBody.description: This endpoint retrieves preapproval information for loans based on the provided criteria. The request should include necessary data to process the preapproval request.

201.description: Preapproval request processed successfully; the loan preapproval has been created.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the preapproval operation in the loan service. It is expected to be a string format.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the preapproval request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the preapproval request.

state.description: The current state of the preapproval process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsResponse_20.description: Response schema for the preapproval operation indicating the result of the request.

createdBy.description: The user who created the preapproval request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the preapproval request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the preapproval request was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the preapproval request.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A lower value typically suggests a faster response time.
